prompt: Which query counts each account's app sessions, where a user's first event starts a session and an event more than 30 minutes after the same user's previous event starts a new one?

options.text:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
)
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes') AS sessions
FROM g
GROUP BY account_id

WITH g AS (
  SELECT account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
)
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes') AS sessions
FROM g
GROUP BY account_id
